understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each level by positioning the selectable piece(s) so that every goal tile marked with a '+' was occupied at the same time, within the limited step budget.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each action consumed one step. Using CLICK on a grid coordinate attempted to move the currently selected piece directly to that target position; if the destination was invalid (e.g., blocked by walls/obstacles or otherwise not a legal placement), the piece did not move. When multiple selectable pieces exist, CLICK can be used to switch/act on a different piece by targeting its position, and all movement/placement is constrained by the level geometry (walls/obstacles) and the step limit.
